title: Introducing ASXR Micro Super CMS
content:
Today we're launching ASXR Micro Super CMS Ω - a unified content operating system built on KUHUL pipeline architecture, XJSON data formats, XCFE control flow governance, and ASX-RAM native memory storage.

Key features:
- Forum system for community discussions
- Marketplace for plugins and licenses
- Plugin directory with version management
- Blog publishing system
- User management and permissions
- RLHF training and annotation
- Memory heatmap visualization
- Agent-based automation

The entire system runs in-browser with service worker architecture and progressive web app capabilities.
author: user-001

title: Understanding the KUHUL Pipeline
content:
The KUHUL pipeline is a five-stage execution model:

1. POP - Parse and initialize
2. WO - Bind world state
3. SEK - Execute core logic
4. XUL - Transform output
5. CH'EN - Emit results

This pipeline ensures causality governance through XCFE control vectors and enables polyglot language support (K'uhul, JavaScript, Java, Python).
author: user-002

title: SECURITY-GOAT: Protecting Your GAS Plugins
content:
SECURITY-GOAT provides comprehensive malware detection for GAS plugins:

- 15+ malware pattern detectors (eval, Function, XSS)
- Threat scoring (0.0 = safe, 1.0 = critical)
- Quarantine management
- Approval workflows
- XCFE enforcement

All plugins are validated before registration and execution through the enhanced KUHUL pipeline: SECURITY → POP → WO → SEK → XUL → CH'EN
